messages:
ron: Heads-up, VendorX wants marketplace SaaS listing but with special onboarding: SSO + org_admin seat auto-provision. Need to map that to AWS/GCP/Azure flows and confirm legal/telemetry. Who owns the onboarding callbacks?

leah: I can own callback wiring. We need a webhook auth token and a replay-protection nonce. Recommend signed JWT in callback query. Also need to confirm redirect URI list for Azure (publisher requires exact matches).

sam: Product: two things - (1) Enterprise plan will use a partner provisioning webhook for license attach, (2) Starter trial must be instant-on with minimal friction. Can we support both?

leah: Yes, we can support both. Flow idea:
1) Marketplace redirects user -> Acme SaaS provisioning endpoint with JWT + plan info.
2) Our callback validates JWT, creates account, attaches starter trial if plan=starter, or flags for partner provisioning if enterprise.
Include sample JWT payload.

sam: Drop sample payload pls. Also confirm whether telemetry opt-in checkbox must be before redirect or after account creation.

leah: Sample JWT (claims):
{
  "iss":"marketplace-publisher",
  "sub":"customer-123",
  "plan":"starter|enterprise",
  "iat":1610000000,
  "exp":1610000600,
  "nonce":"random-hex"
}
Telemetry: legal prefers opt-in during onboarding UI after redirect so user sees the consent box on first run.

claire-legal: Confirming: telemetry must be explicit opt-in (cannot be buried in EULA). For trials, retention default=60 days unless customer requests otherwise. Also confirm data residency: VendorX requires EU-only storage for EU customers  we need account-level region tag. Add clause to manifest notes.

ron: Noted. For AWS KMS: vendor wants to bring their own key for encrypting seeds; we should document optional KMS integration and sample policy. For GCP, document CMEK flow.

build-bot: build-bot: created ticket MKP-820 (VendorX marketplace onboarding: SSO, callbacks, KMS, telemetry) and assigned to @leah/@ron/@sam/@claire-legal. https://boards.internal/issue/MKP-820

sam: Next steps: Leah add callback JWT sample to ticket, Ron add KMS + CMEK notes, Claire add final consent copy and EU retention clause. Quick check-in tomorrow 10:00 PT. If we need legal contact for VendorX reseller terms, tag here.
